about.title: about
about.paragraph_1: the sculpture tells the story of a fire experienced in the 1970s and, more broadly, of the house’s deterioration. near the entrance to the pavel and sergei tretyakov museum, a small additional wall has been built from charred beams. touching it makes it possible to sense both the horror of the fire that engulfed the mansion and hope, since the viewer knows that beyond the wall lies a beautiful new façade, opening a new page in the history of the house.
about.paragraph_2: the charred wall seems about to merge with the house, yet the past is immutable and the black wall cannot be moved. one can only peer into the narrow gap between them and see what the future conceals.
